files.body:
a place to put the things so they're not just in my head at 4am.

---
2026-05-15
I keep doing the math. Colleen was 21. I'm 31. Her daughter was 8 months old. Her daughter is 55 now, older than my mother was when dad died. The whole span of a life happened in the gap between the thing and the telling, and I'm the one it got told to, because I happened to leave the recorder running while I went to get him water.

I didn't earn this. I just didn't turn it off.

---
2026-05-28
Priya asked if I feel guilty for 'using' him. I don't. He wasn't a source. He was a lonely man who thought I was the woman he'd been apologizing to for fifty years, and for four minutes I let him apologize, because who was I to stop him. If that's using someone then every priest is a con man.

---
2026-07-22
He died today. I keep waiting to feel the clean thing, grief or relief, and instead it's this: I'm glad the last thing he did in his own head was say sorry, and I'm furious that saying sorry to me doesn't count, and I don't know where to put a man who was gentle to me and did that.

both things are true. that's the whole problem with people. both things are always true.

---
2026-08-19
The lawyer letter came. 'retention of recordings'. They want me to write them a note confirming I destroyed evidence of a murder. In writing. On letterhead. I laughed out loud in the kitchen and then I couldn't stop and then it wasn't laughing.

---
2026-08-29 (after)
Someone was in here. Nothing's smashed. That's the thing nobody tells you — it's not the mess that scares you, it's the tidiness. Somebody stood where I'm standing and chose what to take and put the rest back. The recorder and the drive. The drive was a decoy, it had ambience on it, room tone, forty minutes of an empty corridor. I hope they listened to the whole thing. I hope they sat in a car and listened to a nursing home breathe and wondered what they were looking for.

The thing that matters was never in this apartment. It's in my head and it's in Paul's safe and it's with a woman in Sackville and as of tonight it's going to be everywhere.

I'm not scared of Derek. I want to write that down so it's true. I'm scared of being the only one who heard it. That's different. You can fix that one.

THE HUM (acoustic log — do not romanticize this, it is a duct)

2026-04-04: 92-96 Hz fundamental, ~6s swell cycle, formant-ish energy 480/1200 that MOVES. loudest outside 17-19. recorded 3 positions.
2026-04-20: still there. maintenance says chillers are the far side. concentrator in 14 but present with 14 empty.
2026-05-13: it's not periodic like a machine. it breathes. writing that down and hating it.
2026-06-04: posted to the forum. mod_hush says edge tone, air over an open duct end, pitch modulated by doors elsewhere. that explains the position dependence. believe the man.
2026-07-10: last clean recording before the reno. it was quieter. almost gone. before they touched anything.
2026-07-18: reno done. new ceiling, new duct hanger. silence.
2026-07-22: alden died. the hum was already gone. I keep needing that order to be a coincidence and it is a coincidence. a dropped duct hanger. sitting on the tile grid. resonating. that is what it was.

liam from the forum was an orderly there 08-10. said the man in 17 used to 'talk to the wall about boats'. 17 is alden's room. it was alden's room for four years.

he was talking to a wall that hummed back and I recorded both of them and I am a sound person and I do not believe in ghosts and I want that on the record. it's ducts. it's grief. it's an old man and a bad building. that's enough. that's more than enough.
